shortDescription: Argentina's President Javier Milei said he would not stop citizens from buying Chinese cars if they want to do so. According to Sina Finance, he said people can buy cars from any country and that what Argentines choose to drive is their own business.

title: Argentina's President Milei Says He Will Not Restrict Purchases of Chinese Cars
